withColdMetadataRequest.reason: Explicit request adapter for inventory-registered COLD consumers. Off mode invokes the original receiver/request literally. Bounded mode borrows the legacy store through the complete route callback and encoding; it never copies or swaps the server or its mutexes. Read and supported mutation lifetimes delegate to the proven replica-wide cancellable cold primitive. SW191 tests the production loop settings route wrappers and store admission, nested lifetime, cancellation and publication; the all-pending production activation gate remains unchanged.
withColdMetadataRequest.temperatureReason: Admission adapter called only by explicit COLD route wrappers.
